svg.title: About me. Motto: complex ≠ complicated. I came to code from marketing and design, and became a front-end developer in 2017, obsessing over pixels, accessibility and the feel of a well-made interface. That obsession moved up the stack. First I built UIs that make dense data usable. Now I build AI agents that do the dense work themselves, and the interfaces that make people trust them. I'm a Senior Engineer at Elcano and the creator and architect of Manifest, an AI deal platform that turns a plain-English brief into live programmatic ad deals. I also build the agent approval experience in Fleet and the LLM classification pipeline in Lens. Around the team I'm the connector queen: I build the MCP servers that let our agents work safely across 9 SSPs.
